summary_for_children: Al-Balad means The City. It says Allah showed us two ways and the steep pass is freeing a slave and feeding the hungry and orphans.
environment_concept: The path forks into two ways (90:10): an easy path that wanders off, and a steep, narrow pass between rocks (90:11). At the top of the pass waits a table set for feeding on a day of hunger (90:14). No person is shown, and the fire of 90:20 is not pictured.
architecture_and_scenery: A forked path, a narrow rocky pass with steps, a table with bread at the top.

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: A mountain village in a hungry year with a storehouse in the valley and three households up a steep zig-zag pass

primary_mechanic.text: Share 18 cups of grain between three households of 3, 1 and 5 people so every person gets the same (2 cups each); a wrong or incomplete share is refused with the per-person count; then carry each share up the steep switchback pass to its door (90:11-16, the steep pass: feeding on a day of hunger).

unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading on the valley track, sharing and carrying up the pass, then a reading on the bend
world_assets: three houses up a steep hill
environment_behaviour: a sack of grain appears at each door it is left at
unique_world.learning_objective: Know that feeding the hungry on a day of hunger is the steep pass (90:11-16)

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The Difficult but Beautiful Path
story_library.children_narration: Doing the right thing is not always easy. Surah Al-Balad describes the difficult path of goodness, including freeing people from bondage, feeding those in need, and encouraging patience and compassion. It reminds us that meaningful choices may require effort.

world_idea.title: The Mountain of Compassion
world_idea.description: Travel through a challenging but safe mountain path, completing practical helping activities and learning why compassion matters.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
